title: Introduce Evidence and Verification Standard with material PR enforcement
business_goal: Make material claims traceable to sources, correctness checks, adversarial review, and independent outcome evidence.
current_behavior: Delivery work items already retain hash-sealed evidence, but do not identify these four claim-level evidence dimensions.
expected_behavior: New work items record claim-level evidence gates; CI blocks uncovered material PR changes without treating the report as merge or trading authority. Universal task-platform intake remains an external unsatisfied requirement.
in_scope: blocking pull request check for uncovered new material paths
fail-closed admission for the two existing local agent CLI entrypoints
workflow_dispatch inventory and retirement of the completed PR818 writer
remove stale frozen-baseline-to-PR-base comparison while retaining PR-delta freeze enforcement
dependencies: existing core.delivery work item and evidence model
acceptance_criteria: Negative tests reject malformed and self-approved claims
PR report is bound to the exact candidate SHA
Legacy inventory remains UNVERIFIED and critical-component backfill is explicitly deferred

Seeded missing, stale, mismatched, and contradictory evidence plus covered and uncovered material paths produce expected findings; define an owned process for recording finding counts, focused CI duration, and reviewer effort, and preserve the baseline as pending until a reviewed PR supplies measurements

The evidence policy names an owner and maintenance process for expanding material path coverage; structural errors and new material changes without a current work-item record fail the PR evidence job, while UNVERIFIED claims remain warnings
Policy states repository PR checks do not intercept every platform task request and branch protection must separately require the stable evidence status
Every changed path is classified as material, verifier-base exempt with rationale and owner, or unclassified; unknown paths and candidate-controlled exemptions fail closed
Local agent submission and supervisor preflight/claim require a committed canonical work item and exact task contract binding.
Caller-supplied approval flags do not authenticate human identity; medium/high-risk patch work remains blocked.
All workflow_dispatch paths are inventoried and external entrypoint gaps remain UNSATISFIED.
The PR818 freeze workflow checks protected base-to-head changes without failing for pre-existing drift already on the PR base; the exact bootstrap exception remains.
architecture_impact: Extends existing offline delivery evidence; does not add runtime wiring or a second ledger.
expected_tests: PYTHONPATH=. pytest -q tests/test_agent_admission.py tests/test_submit_agent_work.py tests/test_agent_supervisor.py tests/governance/test_task_entrypoint_inventory.py tests/governance/test_evidence_contract.py tests/delivery
Parse governance JSON and workflow YAML if a parser is available.
Run local synthetic shell proof: pre-existing baseline drift with empty PR delta passes; a protected base-to-head mutation fails; exact bootstrap branch behavior remains unchanged.
qa_attack_plan: enforcement blocks uncovered material paths but permits explicit UNVERIFIED warnings
unclassified changed paths block and candidate-controlled exemptions are ignored
trusted exemptions require rationale and owner and cannot overlap protected material paths
uat_criteria: Review report accurately distinguishes UNVERIFIED from VERIFIED and does not imply strategy or live readiness.
rollback_plan: Revert the reviewed verifier and workflow enforcement commit to restore report-only behavior while preserving existing delivery evidence records. Do not modify external branch protection through this change.

evidence_standard.applicability_reason: This governance work changes a material delivery contract.

claims.statement: The package detects missing, contradictory, stale, or self-approved evidence, blocks uncovered new material PR paths, and blocks unclassified changed paths.

assumptions.statement: The gate covers only repository PR changes; universal task-platform intake remains unimplemented, and branch protection must separately require the check.

claims.limitation: The implementation claim remains UNVERIFIED pending independent review and exact-head evidence. Universal task-platform intake remains UNSATISFIED; GitHub workflow_dispatch trust, branch protection, and authenticated human approval are not provided.

The change does not claim a hosted trusted-base run on the current PR, required-check branch protection, universal platform intake, direct workflow_dispatch admission, or authenticated approval.
